books.name: 示例词书 · 学术高频

words.example: Reforestation schemes can mitigate the effects of soil erosion in mountainous regions.
words.cloze: Reforestation schemes can ______ the effects of soil erosion in mountainous regions.
words.pitfall: 及物动词，后面必须接宾语；易与 mediate（调解）混淆。

words.example: Air quality in the city centre has deteriorated sharply over the past decade.
words.cloze: Air quality in the city centre has ______ sharply over the past decade.
words.pitfall: 不及物动词，没有被动语态；反义词为 improve。填空时注意句中的完成时形式。

words.example: A substantial proportion of household income is spent on housing and transport.
words.cloze: A ______ proportion of household income is spent on housing and transport.
words.pitfall: 易与 substantive（实质性的、有实质内容的）混淆；修饰比例、数量时常用 substantial。

books.name: 示例词书 · 听力场景

words.example: The conference venue has been changed to the Riverside Hall.
words.cloze: The conference ______ has been changed to the Riverside Hall.
words.pitfall: 听力中常与 avenue（大道）混淆；注意 /v/ 与 /æv/ 的起音差异。

words.example: The meeting has been postponed until next Thursday because of the storm.
words.cloze: The meeting has been ______ until next Thursday because of the storm.
words.pitfall: 后接 until / to 表示推迟到某时，不接 since；与 cancel（取消）含义不同。
